COMING SOON: Missiles that see via the infrared spectral band are a common battlefield threat.\n\nThe signature of your aircraft is provided to them by the heat that operating it produces.

COMING SOON: You can defeat IR missiles by using flares - intense heat signatures - that can either distract or dazzle the seeker head.\n\nEvery aircraft in the arsenal has flares.

COMING SOON: Flare effectiveness is determined by your aspect to the missile, as well as your engine output. Lower your throttle and turn the plane side-on to the threat to get the most out of your flares. If you get fired on from behind at full throttle, or you may need to expend the whole cartridge.
即将推出: 干扰弹的效果取决于你相对导弹的方位，以及发动机推力。收小油门，让机身侧面对着威胁，才能最大限度发挥干扰弹的作用。如果全油门时被从后方攻击，你可能需要把整匣干扰弹全部打光。

COMING SOON: Pre-flaring (releasing flares if you suspect you're about to be fired on) is the most effective use of flares, as it can prevent the launching platform from obtaining a lock.\nTry releasing flares periodically (once or twice a second) when in danger.
即将推出: 预抛干扰弹（怀疑即将遭到攻击时提前投放干扰弹）是干扰弹最有效的用法，因为它能让发射平台无法完成锁定。\n身处险境时，试着每隔一段时间（每秒一到两次）投放一次干扰弹。

COMING SOON: You are pulling away too soon. While the best and most obvious survival method is to avoid the SAM in the first place, for the sake of this demonstration, please take unreasonable risk.
即将推出: 你撤离得太早了。最有效也最明显的求生办法当然是一开始就避开防空导弹，但为了这次演示，请承担不合理的风险。

COMING SOON: Now leave the SAM's area of effect and return to where you started. Because you'll be showing it your exhaust as you fly away, it is especially important that you reduce your throttle to reduce your signature compared to that of your flares.
即将推出: 现在离开防空导弹的作用范围，返回你出发的位置。因为你飞离时会把尾喷口对着它，所以尤其重要的是收小油门，让自己的信号特征低于干扰弹。

COMING SOON: Well done, you've entered the IR SAM's area of effect and come back alive.\n\nThis completes the training, but if you still have flares left, feel free to resume and continue tempting fate.

COMING SOON: The emission from the radar is detectable by your radar receiver, and the direction to the radar is indicated by an orange line on the minimap. As radar based detection relies on bouncing a signal off of something, you can detect radar emissions at approximately double the range of a radar system.

COMING SOON: Having received an emission doesn't necessarily mean you have been spotted - it just means you have detected that a radar is being used.
即将推出: 接收到辐射并不一定意味着你已被发现——它只说明你探测到了有雷达正在工作。

COMING SOON: Radar pings appear as lines on your minimap\n
即将推出: 雷达脉冲会以小地图上的线条显示\n

COMING SOON: In this instance, however, you have definitely been spotted. The radar has a range of approximately 40km, and is only 15km away.\nThe radar will now be used to guide a Stratolance missile into you.
即将推出: 但在此例中，你确实已经被发现。该雷达的探测距离约为 40 公里，而它距你只有 15 公里。\n该雷达现在将用于引导一枚平流层长矛导弹攻击你。

COMING SOON: The bright light rising up off of the island is a Stratolance missile. You have been fired at.\n\nAs you are high in the air and well within the range of the missile, the only way to survive this encounter is by executing a notch.
即将推出: 从岛上腾空而起的亮光是一枚平流层长矛导弹。敌方已向你开火。\n\n由于你身处高空、完全处于导弹射程之内，唯一能活下来的办法就是执行侧切。

COMING SOON: Notching, in short, can be described as flying perpendicular to the enemy radar.\n\nDoing this removes the doppler shift from your return frequencies, making it harder for the radar to track you.
即将推出: 简而言之，侧切就是与敌方雷达保持垂直方向飞行。\n\n这样可消除你回波频率上的多普勒频移，使雷达更难跟踪你。

COMING SOON: Our goal will be to get to cover behind the mountains. Start by breaking right, diving toward the water's surface, and getting the incoming radar line to stay at your 9 o'clock.\nYou should also select your Radar ECM by pressing Next Countermeasures {0}
即将推出: 我们的目标是躲到山后的掩护中。先向右急转脱离，朝水面向下俯冲，让来袭的雷达连线保持在你的 9 点钟方向。\n你还应按下一对抗措施按钮 {0} 选择雷达干扰。

COMING SOON: Now that the missile is close enough to be picked up and analysed by your sensors, a notch guide is provided both on the HUD and minimap.\n\nThe yellow dotted line indicates the ideal heading to maintain in order to perform a notch.
即将推出: 现在导弹已足够近，可被你的传感器截获并分析，平显和小地图上都会给出侧切引导。\n\n黄色虚线表示执行侧切时应保持的理想航向。

COMING SOON: Notching alone is rarely enough to defeat a missile, especially in less stealthy aircraft.\nWhile in the notch envelope however, is the ideal time to use your ECM. The lack of doppler shifted returns, combined with the radar ECM, should mask you from the radar.
即将推出: 仅靠侧切很少足以摆脱导弹，尤其是在隐身性较差的飞机上。\n不过，处于侧切包线内时，正是使用电子对抗的最佳时机。缺少多普勒回波，再加上雷达干扰，应当能让雷达看不见你。

COMING SOON: The tracking must be broken for at least 3 seconds for the missile to not re-acquire.\nNote that even when the missile loses track, it will still head for the last calculated intercept point. You must take care to evade whilst not exiting the notch.
即将推出: 跟踪必须中断至少 3 秒，导弹才不会重新捕获。\n注意，即使导弹失去跟踪，它仍会飞向最后计算出的拦截点。你必须在规避的同时不要脱离侧切。

COMING SOON: The jammer's effectiveness is proportional to remaining capacitor charge. It is best used in 3 second bursts per missile.\n\nUse the jammer {0} while notching to escape toward the coast.
即将推出: 干扰机的效果与剩余电容电量成正比。最好对每枚导弹以每次 3 秒的方式使用。\n在侧切的同时使用干扰机 {0}，向海岸方向脱离。

COMING SOON: Congratulations - you've successfully avoided radar missiles in a worst case scenario.\nIdeally, you can avoid these missiles by breaking line of sight of the radar, or by hugging the surface as tightly as possible to stay within ground clutter. Feel free to resume and practice this.
即将推出: 恭喜——你在最坏的情况下成功规避了雷达导弹。\n理想情况下，你可以通过切断与雷达的视线，或尽可能贴地飞行保持在杂波中来避开这些导弹。随时可以重新开始并练习。
